title: Fake Roaming Alert
scenario: A text says roaming charges are extreme and asks you to install a savings profile.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.C: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Fake Roaming Alert: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Carrier settings should be changed in the carrier app.
